name: Hearth Spirit
description: A tiny example of the God-play extension points: two designation kinds (shrine ground in data, an offering spot in code), two powers (a golden rain on a place, a gift of bread to a character), one resource (favour) and one demand template (an offering at the shrine). Not a game: a proof that a God package can be pure content.
author: Tablefolk
